service_cnc-machining_desc: High-precision machining for complex parts. Our modern 3-, 4-, and 5-axis CNC machining centers can produce complex geometries with tight tolerances and excellent surface finishes.
service_cnc-machining_hero_subtitle: Versatile milling & turning for complex geometries

service_sheet-metal_hero_subtitle: Custom solutions for cutting, bending, and forming
service_sheet-metal_hero_subheading: Precision sheet metal parts for prototyping and production.

service_3d-printing_hero_subtitle: Additive manufacturing for prototypes and production
service_injection-molding_desc: Cost-effective solution for mass production of plastic parts. Our injection molding services include tool design, manufacturing, and production for consistent quality.
service_injection-molding_hero_title: Injection Molded Parts – Order Online Easily
service_surface-finish_desc: Comprehensive surface treatment services to enhance the appearance, durability, and functionality of your parts. We offer various finishing options to meet your specific requirements.

service_rapid-prototyping_desc: Accelerate your product development with fast, flexible prototyping solutions. We offer quick prototypes with 3D printing, CNC machining, and vacuum casting to validate your designs before production.

about_hero_subtitle: We're on a mission to revolutionize manufacturing in Greece through digital innovation and precision engineering.
about_our_story_p1: Microns Hub was founded in 2020 with a vision to transform the manufacturing industry in Greece. We recognized the challenges businesses face when trying to source quality manufacturing services.
about_our_story_p2: Our team of engineers and manufacturing experts came together to build an on-demand manufacturing platform that leverages digital technology to streamline the entire process from design to delivery.
about_our_story_p3: Today, we're proud to be Greece's leading on-demand manufacturing platform, connecting businesses of all sizes with high-quality production capabilities while maintaining the highest standards of quality and service.
about_mission_values_subtitle: We're guided by a commitment to excellence and innovation in everything we do
about_mission_desc: To democratize access to high-quality manufacturing services and empower businesses to bring their ideas to life efficiently and cost-effectively.
about_vision_desc: To become the leading manufacturing platform in Europe, known for quality, speed, and technological innovation in the industry.
about_promise_desc: To deliver precision parts with outstanding quality, on time, every time - backed by our 100% satisfaction guarantee.

about_innovation_desc: We continuously evolve our technology and processes
about_reliability_desc: We deliver on our promises, consistently
about_transparency_desc: We maintain clear communication and fair pricing
about_quality_assurance_desc: Quality is at the core of everything we do. Every part we produce undergoes rigorous inspection to ensure it meets our exacting standards and your specific requirements.
about_quality1_desc: Our quality management system is ISO certified, ensuring consistent quality across all processes.
about_quality2_desc: We use coordinate measuring machines (CMM) and 3D scanning to verify dimensional accuracy.
about_quality3_desc: We provide material certifications and traceability for critical applications when required.
about_facilities_desc: Our state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities are equipped with the latest technology and machinery to deliver precision parts and exceptional quality.
about_facility1_desc: 15,000 sq.ft. facility with modern CNC machines and automated production lines
about_facility2_desc: Dedicated space for quality inspection with cutting-edge measuring equipment
about_facility3_desc: Specialized area for secure packaging, quality checks, and efficient order dispatching
footer_company_desc: Microns Hub is Greece's premier on-demand manufacturing platform, specializing in precision CNC machining, sheet metal fabrication and more.
industries_hero_desc: Our manufacturing expertise spans diverse industries, providing tailored solutions for specialized applications and unique challenges.
industry_aerospace_desc: We deliver high-precision, lightweight components for the aerospace industry that meet strict safety standards and certification requirements.
industry_automotive_desc: Our automotive manufacturing solutions help deliver quality parts for both traditional and electric vehicles with tight tolerances and excellent surface finishes.
industry_consumer-goods_desc: We help consumer product companies bring innovations to market with rapid prototyping, design validation, and production-ready parts.
industry_education_desc: Supporting educational institutions with precise components for research, teaching aids, and laboratory equipment.
industry_electronics_desc: We manufacture precision enclosures, heat sinks, and components for electronic devices with excellent thermal and EMI characteristics.
industry_energy_desc: Our manufacturing capabilities support the energy sector with durable components for harsh environments and specialized applications.
industry_engineering_desc: We provide engineering firms with precision machined parts, prototypes and testing fixtures to support their design and development process.
industry_machine-building_desc: We supply critical components for industrial machinery with tight tolerances and exceptional reliability for continuous operation.

industry_robotics_desc: We produce precision components for robotics and automation systems that require exceptional accuracy and reliability.

quote_page_subtitle: Upload your CAD files and get a detailed quote within 24 hours. Our team of experts is ready to bring your designs to life.
quote_page_faq_file_formats_question: What file formats do you accept?
quote_page_faq_file_formats_answer: We accept all major CAD formats including STEP, STL, IGES, DXF, DWG, and more. For best results, we recommend STEP files as they preserve the most detail.
quote_page_faq_manufacturing_time_answer: Typical lead times range from 1-3 weeks depending on complexity and quantity. We offer expedited options for urgent projects.
quote_page_faq_quote_info_question: What information do I need for a quote?
quote_page_faq_quote_info_answer: We need your CAD files, material preferences, quantity requirements, and any specific tolerances or surface finish requirements.
quote_page_faq_min_order_question: Is there a minimum order quantity?
quote_page_faq_min_order_answer: No, we accept orders of any size from single prototypes to large production runs. Each project is quoted individually.
quote_page_faq_manufacturing_method_ques: How do you choose the best manufacturing method?
quote_page_faq_manufacturing_method_answ: Our engineers analyze your design, requirements, and quantity to recommend the most cost-effective and suitable manufacturing process.
